May 16, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Wright Investors Service Inc decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 6.9% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wright Investors Service Inc sold 2,101 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 28,340 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.00M, down from 30,441 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wright Investors Service Inc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $533.54B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.24% or $2.32 during the last trading session, reaching $184.32. About 14.26M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
Craig C. Albert increased its stake in Cornerstone Ondemand Inc (CSOD) by 7.13% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sheffield Asset Management Llc bought 58,900 shares as the company’s stock rose 10.52% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Craig C. Albert held 885,163 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $31.27M, up from 826,263 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sheffield Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Cornerstone Ondemand Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.71 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.55% or $0.26 during the last trading session, reaching $46.94. About 590,408 shares traded or 4.56% up from the average. Cornerstone OnDemand, Inc. (NASDAQ:CSOD) has declined 1.02% since May 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 12.57% the S&P500.
